court_record.dd: DESIGN DD 2026-07-06 (50 tool calls, live surface): (1) THE PREMISE SPLIT — 'insurance is cheap' is HALF-refuted: ATM 3mo IV 14.9% / VIX 16.4 (35th %ile) = the BODY is cheap, but SKEW 150 = top of range and the 25%-OTM strike costs 2.1x ATM vol = THE TAIL IS RICH — own the cheap part, rent the expensive part sparingly (20% OTM not 25-30%); (2) THE 2022 FAILURE MODE QUANTIFIED: a -25% grind w/ VIX<36 pays a rolled 25%-OTM program ~ZERO for a full year of bleed (intrinsic ~$0.75/pt, monetization never triggers) — the reason for closer strikes + the VIX leg; (3) HONEST EV: breakeven needs P(>=35% drawdown) ~7.3%/yr vs base rate 6.5-8.5% = standalone ~EV-neutral-to-negative; the real justification = the REBALANCING PREMIUM + the bridge; (4) DOMINANCE: the household's own convexity ($5M Sept + the December engine + resting ladders) DOMINATES a perpetual program post-September — the only uncovered gaps are (a) a crash in the ~10-week pre-cash window and (b) depth >35%; hence BRIDGE not subscription; (5) TAIL/CAOS rejected (10x the capital for 1/3 the multiple); SPY options rejected (ordinary ST vs 1256's ~26.8% blended — a verified 10.2pp federal edge); (6) VIX legs must be TRADED on spikes never held to settlement (path risk quantified).
court_record.adjudication: presiding desk: the design's own Mode B was the court (EV table, 2022 quantification, dominance analysis); ADOPTION = the user's call — a new program class and a $37k premium spend
court_record.user_adjudication: THE KILL (user, one sentence): 'we can just use the September tranche to buy back -- it's not dependent on no drawdown.' Decoded: the $5M arrives UNCONDITIONALLY; a pre-Sept crash makes it buy ~40% more; no leverage/margin/liquidity channel forces sales at lows, so window drawdowns are marked never realized; the December engine converts drawdowns into ~50%-subsidized tax assets. A structural net buyer should WANT the crash while the money is in transit -- the bridge was insurance against receiving a discount. The design's dominance analysis reached this conclusion for September but failed to apply it to its OWN bridge: the 'time gap' exists only for a forced seller. The Spitznagel residual (hedge payout = extra bottom-tick powder) survives as logic, fails on magnitude beside an unconditional $5M at ~neutral EV and top-of-range skew. RE-OPEN CONDITIONS: (1) the book takes on LEVERAGE (the 2026 plan contemplates it -- leverage creates the forced-selling channel that makes insurance economic); (2) a real liquidity need collateralized by the equity; (3) decumulation. Absent those: drawdowns are the plan working.

edge_explainer.market_believes: (The skew says) everyone wants the deep tail — it's the most expensive point on the surface while the body sleeps at the 35th percentile.
edge_explainer.we_believe: The household is already structurally long the crash — September's cash buys any post-September panic and December's engine monetizes the losses. The only things money can't yet buy are TIME (the 10 weeks before the cash lands) and DEPTH (>35%, where rebalancing can't keep up). Buy exactly those two, at the cheap part of the surface, with the exits written before the entry.
edge_explainer.why_we_might_have_edge: Not edge — insurance, honestly labeled, plus the mechanical rebalancing premium most programs leave to mid-crash willpower.
edge_explainer.why_it_might_be_priced_in: The tail IS priced in — SKEW 150 says so; that's why the design refuses the 25-30% strikes.
edge_explainer.what_resolves_it: Sep-18 expiry (the bridge's own frozen grade: 88% it expires worthless — the honest cost of covering the gap); any VIX>=40 event fires the pre-registered tranches.
edge_explainer.mechanism_falsifier: A 2022-style grind: -20%+ with VIX pinned under 35 pays the bridge little — the residual covered only by the VIX 30Cs at partial value.
edge_explainer.edge_type: insurance program; NOT staged — awaiting the user's adopt/modify/pass

insurance_grid_2026_07_07.headline: the SHELVED design's instrument was WRONG for the post-deployment household: XSP/SPX puts = straddle POISON (~100% overlap vs the S&P-replicating DI sleeves, defers harvested losses); the corrected core = NDX put-spreads (straddle-safe ~45-55% overlap under the 70% wall, +20% premium cost offset by 1.15-1.3x tech-crash beta matching the household's ACTUAL exposure) + VIX ladders (no straddle question, the only clean deep-spike leg)
insurance_grid_2026_07_07.budget_reality: full $16M coverage = ~$695k/yr (4.35%); $40k/$80k/$160k budgets buy SLICES: 0.25% = spike-alarm OR a $1.4M grind-slice; 0.5% = the sweet spot (NDX 10/25 spread on ~$1.8M + VIX 30/40 kicker: ~$343k recovery in any fast crash <= -25%, ~$231k in a -25% GRIND — the zone outright 20%-OTM puts pay ZERO); 1.0% = the barbell adds the only UNCAPPED tail (12mo NDX 10% outright on ~$1.5M)
insurance_grid_2026_07_07.skew_harvest: SKEW 150 = the 25%-OTM wing trades 31% IV vs 21.5% ATM (~top decile) -> selling it finances 29% of the near put; the 10/25 spread is 29% cheaper than outright; NEVER sell below the 25 strike (financing <20% while giving away the catastrophe)
insurance_grid_2026_07_07.tax_findings: (1) premium bleed is ~40% tax-subsidized (1256 60/40 losses absorbed by the harvest machine; 3yr carryback vs prior 1256 gains — verify offsets exist); (2) THE COLLAR TAX-FLIP: sold INDEX calls are 1256, so the no-premium-selling rule (built for ST-ordinary equity options) does NOT apply — a 10%-OTM call funds the whole 10/25 spread to a net credit; the true cost = the melt-up give-up ($1.6-1.9M in a +20% year on $16M) — collars only with a firm limited-upside view
insurance_grid_2026_07_07.ev_verdict: self-insurance (the defensive sleeve at 4.3% state-exempt + Sept dry powder + the harvest engine) BEATS premium insurance in expectation (a -30%+ drawdown ~1-per-10-15yrs vs $384k 10yr after-tax NPV at the 0.5% tier); any structure above = a deliberate VARIANCE/BEHAVIORAL purchase, never alpha — consistent with the original kill
